dev.description: Start the Astro dev server in background mode
dev.template: Run `astro dev --background` to start the dev server. Use `astro dev status` to check status, `astro dev logs` to see logs, and `astro dev stop` to stop.

build.template: Run `npm run build` to build the site for production deployment.

preview.template: Run `npm run preview` to preview the production build.

format.template: Run `npx prettier --write .` to format all files with Prettier.

lint.template: Run `npx stylelint "src/**/*.css"` to lint CSS files.
